description: Average retail prices of 30 goods and services in Poland from GUS (bread, butter, milk, eggs, meat, vegetables, sugar, electricity, gas, heating, petrol, diesel, bus ticket, taxi, haircut, doctor visit, cinema) for the latest month, with change vs the previous month and the same month a year earlier and the minutes of work each costs at the average net wage; plus the finwire shopping basket of 10 staple foods (finwire_shopping_basket_index).

product.description: Product name in Polish, e.g. "masło", "chleb", "benzyna"; returns that item with its monthly price history. Omit for all items.

name: get_retail_prices
title: Retail prices in shops (GUS)
